docs.title: Parking Lot Notice
sents: Attention, all employees.
The north parking lot will be closed on Friday, June 6, for repainting.
Please use the south parking lot or the street parking on Oak Avenue instead.
The north lot will reopen on Monday morning.
We apologize for any inconvenience.

docs.title: Sunny Bakery
sents: Sunny Bakery is celebrating its tenth anniversary!
From May 1 to May 7, all cakes are 20 percent off.
Customers who spend more than $30 will also receive a free loaf of bread.
We are open every day from 7 A.M. to 8 P.M.
Visit us at 45 River Street.

docs.title: Your order
sents: Dear Mr. Lee,
Thank you for ordering from Office Plus.
Your order of two desk lamps and a box of pens was shipped today.
It should arrive within three business days.
Unfortunately, the blue notebooks you ordered are out of stock, so we have not charged you for them.
We will e-mail you when they are available again.
Sincerely, Office Plus Customer Service

docs.title: Local café expands
sents: Brewed Awakening, a small coffee shop that opened downtown three years ago, will open its second location next month.
The new café will be located near Westfield University.
Owner Sara Kim said that many students had asked her to open a shop closer to campus.
The new location will feature a larger seating area and longer hours to accommodate students who study late.
Ms. Kim also plans to hire about fifteen part-time workers, most of whom she hopes will be students.

docs.title: Office Renovation
sents: To: All Staff
From: Facilities Department
Starting next Monday, the third floor will be renovated.
During the two-week project, employees on that floor will work from the conference rooms on the first floor.
Please pack your personal items by Friday afternoon; boxes are available in the mail room.
Computers will be moved by the IT team, so you do not need to disconnect them yourself.
If you have questions, contact Tom Hayes at extension 214.

docs.title: Welcome to the team
sents: Dear Ms. Alvarez,
On behalf of everyone at Greenline Marketing, welcome to the team!
Your first day will be Monday, March 3.
Please arrive at 9 A.M. and check in at the reception desk on the fifth floor.
During your first week, you will attend training sessions on our software and company policies.
Your manager, Mr. Gordon, will meet you for lunch on Wednesday to discuss your first project.
Best regards, Human Resources

docs.title: Riverton's new transit plan
sents: The Riverton City Council approved a plan on Tuesday to add three new bus routes connecting the suburbs to the downtown business district.
Officials say the routes, which will begin service in September, are expected to reduce traffic on Highway 9 by up to 15 percent.
The project will be funded largely through a federal transportation grant, so local taxes will not increase.
However, some residents have voiced concerns that the new routes will pass through quiet residential streets.
In response, the council has agreed to hold two public meetings in August to gather feedback before the final routes are set.

docs.title: Letter to a supplier
sents: Dear Mr. Novak,
I am writing regarding our recent order of 500 ceramic mugs, which arrived on April 12.
While most of the mugs were in excellent condition, approximately 40 were cracked, apparently due to insufficient packaging.
As we have worked with Novak Ceramics for over six years, I am confident this was an isolated incident.
Nevertheless, our café chain needs the full order before our spring promotion begins on May 1.
I would appreciate it if you could ship replacements as soon as possible and confirm the expected delivery date.
In addition, I suggest using thicker boxes for future shipments.
Sincerely, Laura Chen, Purchasing Manager, Bean & Leaf Cafés

docs.title: City Fitness Center
sents: City Fitness Center — Summer Membership Special

docs.title: Hotel chain to go paperless
sents: Harborview Hotels announced last week that all 40 of its locations will stop printing guest receipts and room-service menus by the end of the year.
Instead, guests will receive receipts by e-mail and view menus on in-room tablets.
The company estimates the change will save about 2 million sheets of paper annually.
Guests who still prefer paper copies can request them at the front desk.

docs.title: Guest feedback
sents: To: Harborview Hotels Customer Relations
From: Martin Clarke
I stayed at your Lakeside location last weekend and noticed that the room-service menu was available only on a tablet.
As someone who is not comfortable with technology, I found it confusing at first.
However, a staff member at the front desk kindly printed a menu for me within minutes.
I appreciate your environmental efforts, but I recommend placing a small card in each room explaining that paper menus are available.
